spans.s: SR0145 ग्रीवा grīvā Cervix or neck. A part of an organ resembling a neck.
SR0146 ग्रीवाधः (ग्र) सन्धिः grīvādhaḥ (gra) sandhiḥ Sternoclavicular joints. The joint space between the sternum and the medial extremity of the clavicle
SR0147 ग्रीवामूलम् grīvāmūlam Suprasternal notch. Notch above the sternum.
